diagnostics.message: delete_http_settings must run before the probe is removed (HTTP settings reference the probe via enable_probe/probe), but no dependency expresses that: its depends_on lists the create-time set_probe rather than the cleanup resource delete_probe. It should depend on delete_probe so the HTTP-settings cleanup is destroyed before the probe cleanup.

set_probe depends_on set_backend_pools (the probe is provisioned after the backend pool), but delete_probe declares no depends_on at all. On destroy the probe must be removed before the backend pool it is associated with, so delete_probe should depend on delete_backend_pool to mirror the create-time ordering.

The HTTP listener references a frontend port (set_http_listener depends_on set_frontend_port), so on destroy the listener cleanup must happen before the frontend-port cleanup. delete_http_listener instead lists the create-time set_frontend_port, which establishes no destroy ordering; it should depend on delete_frontend_port.
